registered_markings.scope: Actual registered material volumes, tool-selected native paths above their body face and nominal line-width footprints. Source islands include glyph outlines, faucet mark and QR-connected islands; counts are not character counts or a scan result. Native filament_map selects the extruder offset; GCode::gcode_to_point restores the source XY coordinate frame by adding that offset to the selected filament G-code paths. No physical colour registration, QR scanning or legibility acceptance is inferred.

source_collar.scope: Retained frozen source review of all three four-letter SODA faces; source assembly preview blue/white, reviewed loaded native project black/white. Byte-identical editable project and native archive.

reading.scope: Negative-space underside identity review. Actual STL bed-section channels are compared with positive native road centerlines buffered by half their commanded width on the open recess layers. Coverage is a nominal strand-width footprint, not physical bead shape, recess depth or legibility.

Positive native model centerlines in CAD marking windows. XY labels exclude nominal slabs touching the body face; side labels exclude centerlines inside the plain side face. Path retention does not establish physical legibility.

visual_review: Actual path/width overlays retain the faucet mark, HOME SODA MACHINE wordmark, QR islands, DATA/TAP/CO2/OVER, three R codes, three Q values and the three underside identity strings. Plus-Y side plots use positive manufacturing X; the readable face view reverses horizontal X. No missing-identifier correction is required.
limits: Unprinted V3: commanded geometry/path footprints do not establish physical colour registration, QR scanning, legibility, release, force, fit, sealing, surface quality or lifetime.
